reason: E1 supports thermal/radiation stability and grain refinement in a nanocrystalline RHEA, and E3 shows improved ductility in nanograined RHEA pillars, but no cited evidence directly supports that nanostructuring suppresses precipitates or that severe thermomechanical processing produces the required homogeneous nanocrystalline state in these alloys.
premises: Nanocrystalline RHEAs can exhibit high thermal stability and radiation resistance
Grain refinement under irradiation and resistance to grain growth are achievable in nanocrystalline RHEAs
Nanocrystalline RHEAs can show improved ductility compared to bulk forms
Severe thermomechanical processing can produce a homogeneous nanocrystalline microstructure in RHEAs
